# CloseButton { #anylumino.CloseButton }

```python
CloseButton(label='Close', *, disabled=False, callbacks=None, **kwargs)
```

Compact close-style action button.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type     | Description                                                           | Default   |
|-----------|----------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| label     | optional | Accessible label or visible label, depending on the component.        | `'Close'` |
| disabled  | optional | Whether user interaction is disabled.                                 | `False`   |
| callbacks | optional | Optional callbacks invoked when the widget sends an activation event. | `None`    |
